verdict.rationale: Requesty is presented entirely as a hosted cloud gateway/router service (router.requesty.ai, EU routing region, hosted dashboard, pricing based on spend) with no mention of a self-hosted or on-premise deployment option, Docker image, or open-source core anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: any self-hosting docs, open-source repo, on-prem deployment guide, or Docker/Kubernetes install instructions.
